description: This file defines a LangFuseLogger class for logging events to Langfuse, including methods for initializing clients, adding metadata, logging events, and handling different response types. It also includes utility functions for masking data, adding prompts, and logging provider-specific info as spans.

classes.name: LangFuseLogger
classes.description: A class for logging events and metrics to Langfuse, managing client initialization, metadata, and response handling.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the LangFuseLogger, sets up Langfuse client, environment variables, and upstream configurations.

methods.name: safe_init_langfuse_client
methods.description: Safely initializes a Langfuse client, ensuring max client count is not exceeded.

methods.name: add_metadata_from_header
methods.description: Adds metadata from proxy request headers to Langfuse logging if keys start with 'langfuse_'.

methods.name: log_event_on_langfuse
methods.description: Logs success or error events to Langfuse, handling different response types and metadata.

methods.name: _get_langfuse_input_output_content
methods.description: Extracts input and output content from responses for Langfuse logging based on response type.

methods.name: _async_log_event
methods.description: Placeholder for asynchronous event logging (not implemented).

methods.name: _is_langfuse_v2
methods.description: Checks if the current Langfuse SDK version is >= 2.0.0.

methods.name: _log_langfuse_v1
methods.description: Logs events to Langfuse v1 API, creating traces and generations.

methods.name: _log_langfuse_v2
methods.description: Logs events to Langfuse v2 API, with detailed metadata, tags, and span management.

methods.name: _get_chat_content_for_langfuse
methods.description: Extracts chat message content from ModelResponse for Langfuse.

methods.name: _get_text_completion_content_for_langfuse
methods.description: Extracts text completion content from TextCompletionResponse for Langfuse.

methods.name: _get_responses_api_content_for_langfuse
methods.description: Extracts responses API content for Langfuse.

methods.name: _get_langfuse_tags
methods.description: Retrieves request tags from standard logging payload.

methods.name: add_default_langfuse_tags
methods.description: Adds default tags like cache_hit and cache_key based on configuration.

methods.name: _supports_tags
methods.description: Checks if current SDK version supports tags.

methods.name: _supports_prompt
methods.description: Checks if current SDK version supports prompt.

methods.name: _supports_costs
methods.description: Checks if current SDK version supports costs.

methods.name: _supports_completion_start_time
methods.description: Checks if current SDK version supports completion start time.

methods.name: _apply_masking_function
methods.description: Recursively applies a masking function to data structures.

methods.name: _get_langfuse_flush_interval
methods.description: Retrieves flush interval from environment or uses default.

methods.name: _log_guardrail_information_as_span
methods.description: Logs guardrail info as spans in tracing.
